shipped_model: pen_stack.twin.position_effect.PositionEffectModel (v7.3.0 human K562 head; factored f_cassette + g_context, conformal + OOD)
label: measured Leemans 2019 K562 TRIP steady-state integrated-reporter expression (NON-circular: the measured label, not a model claim)

acceptance.rule: independent variant must beat the best learned heterochromatin baseline by delta>=0.05 with the bootstrap 95% CI of the margin excluding 0

mouse_to_human_sealed_null.note: the shipped mouse-TRIP-trained axis applied cross-species to human K562 (the pre-registered mouse-axis test). Distinct held-out split from the fresh human-head run above.

cross_cell_resolution_matrix_matched_sou.note: ENCODE fold-change features BOTH sides, same 5 marks, z-scored within dataset -> isolates species/cell-type from the van-Steensel-vs-ENCODE source confound. Coarse 1kb atlas resolution: even a human-trained model on human K562 tops out at ~0.16, so the 0.57 head requires exact-site per-locus features at serve time.

silencing_classifier.note: the Leemans escaper/repressed label is not predictable from chromatin marks (chance AUROC) -> ship the expression head only; the silenced classifier is flagged not-validated

source_files.P2_MATCHED_TRANSFER.json: matched-source (ENCODE both sides) cross-species/resolution transfer matrix
